jobs.prompt: Ultra-minimal dark product-film background plate. A large sheet of smoked black glass in a pitch-dark studio, a single thin horizontal slit of cool white light grazing across the glass from the right edge, falling off to pure black. Extremely shallow depth of field, very fine film grain, near-black tones (#0A0A0B) with soft blue-grey highlights. The left two-thirds of the frame is empty dark negative space reserved for typography. No text, no letters, no logos, no devices, no people. Photographic, high-end technology commercial, 16:9.

Ultra-minimal dark product-film background plate. Extremely shallow depth of field, very fine film grain, near-black tones (#0A0A0B) with soft blue-grey highlights. The left two-thirds of the frame is empty dark negative space reserved for typography. No text, no letters, no logos, no devices, no people. Photographic, high-end technology commercial, 16:9.

Macro product photograph in near darkness of a low-profile aluminium keyboard: one small square modifier key next to the left end of a long space bar, matte black keycaps with completely blank tops (no legends, no symbols, no letters), thin cool rim light tracing the key edges, razor-thin depth of field focused on the small key, background falling off to black. Generic keyboard with no brand marks or logos, no hands. Premium technology commercial lighting, 16:9.

Matte black keycaps with completely blank tops (no legends, no symbols, no letters), a single cool blue-white rim light from behind tracing the key edges, background falling off to black. Generic keyboard with no brand marks or logos, no hands. Premium technology commercial lighting, 16:9.

Abstract light ribbon: a single smooth, wide ribbon of soft cool-white light with a faint blue edge sweeping diagonally from bottom-left to top-right through a black void, refracted as if through frosted glass, gently motion-blurred edges, elegant and minimal, mostly black frame. No text, no logos, no objects. 16:9.

phases.purpose: Image-to-video from the approved keyframe of each plate. 2 takes per plate. Sound off (all audio is produced in post).

jobs.prompt: Locked-off camera with an almost imperceptible slow push-in. The thin slit of light drifts very slowly across the smoked black glass and the reflection breathes softly. Calm, silent, minimal, no new objects appear, no text.

Static macro shot, very slow parallax drift. At around two seconds the small modifier key and the space bar are pressed down together once, quickly and decisively, travel about two millimetres and stay down; the rim light glints along the key edges as they move. No hands, no fingers, nothing else moves, keycaps stay blank.

The ribbon of light sweeps smoothly from bottom-left to top-right across the whole frame, briefly flooding the frame with soft luminous grey light at its brightest moment, then recedes to black. Slow, elegant, continuous motion, slight camera drift, no text, no objects.
